scope: Retain the three supplied archive convictions; independently judge only the six specified members. No specimen or remote payload was executed.
verdict_basis: Deceptive credential theft and remote execution in the first two; fixed destructive operations, quiet execution and no maintenance interface in the four Windows exports. No deployment circumstances or successful execution were assumed.

installer.identification: Universal Mach-O wrapping an encrypted AppleScript credential and file stealer
installer.execution: ARM64 entry0 at 0x100000690 calls the string builder at 0x1000006ac and system at 0x1000006b8. The decoder XORs bytes using low state bits, then updates ((state * 0x3785) & 0xffffffff) % 35999, seeded with 0x11667. Independently recovered all 37077 bytes; ciphertext is identical at offsets 0x4c90 and 0x14de0 in the two slices. The decoded osascript command evaluates its return-joined source.
effects: Installation password dialog masks input and checks it with dscl authonly; the supplied password is saved and reused.

Copies Chromium and Gecko credentials/cookies, extension and desktop wallet stores, login Keychain, Notes databases and selected personal files to random temporary staging. Finder copying and Notes scripting provide alternative collection paths.
ditto archives staging, curl POSTs the ZIP to the configured HTTP host, then deletes staging and the ZIP.
Downloads Ledger Live replacement files, kills and removes the installed wallet app with the captured password, and extracts into Applications.
Downloads command text into a bash -c LaunchDaemon template with RunAtLoad/KeepAlive, installs and bootstraps it via sudo; nohup executes the command as fallback.
installer.limitations: No runtime execution or server response was observed. The upload retry omits a handler argument. Package postinstall actions are not attributed to this member.
installer.marker_note: Installer stealer: steals logins; user-env query detection added

writer.identification: parser-session 1.1.9 writer.js environment stealer and remote response evaluator
writer.execution: On module loading, gathers process.env, OS platform, hostname, userInfo username and noninternal IPv4-interface MAC addresses. Pairwise parseInt(...,16)/fromCharCode decoding reconstructs Axios, post, endpoint, header keys and then. Calling its export POSTs that object and evaluates r.data; promise errors are swallowed.
writer.limitations: Its ../package.json resolves to absent src/package.json; src/index.js also refers to an absent .pnpm/httpreslog writer. Activation in this recovered layout is not established. Those packaging defects do not change the malicious implemented source-to-POST and response-to-eval operations.
writer.marker_note: parser-session writer: exports environment; evaluates server replies

v.execution: The zero-argument export calls genuine child_process.execSync with forced recursive quiet DEL targeting C:\Windows\System32\*.dll, shell:true and ignored stdio; errors are swallowed.
v.limitations: Windows, sufficient rights and invocation are required. Deletion is not secure erasure; no escalation is implemented.
v.marker_note: osinthell v.js: silently deletes Windows system DLLs

f.execution: The export opens PhysicalDrive0 r+, allocates 512 zero bytes, writes that buffer through the same handle at offset zero and closes it. A separate try invokes bootrec /fixmbr with ignored output.
effects: Zeroes the physical disk first sector, including partition metadata
f.limitations: Repair does not restore the erased partition table. Windows rights and success are unknown; no privilege escalation is implemented.
f.marker_note: osinthell f.js: zeroes physical-drive boot sector

p.execution: For C/D/E/F roots, readdirSync returns entries, path.join forms each path, statSync(...).isFile selects regular files, and two-argument writeFileSync(path, empty-string) truncates contents. Nested catches continue after errors.
effects: Destroys contents of regular files at drive roots
p.limitations: It does not recurse, encrypt, securely erase or elevate. Existing overlapping supported detections are retained.
p.marker_note: osinthell p.js: truncates files across drive roots

t.execution: The export calls genuine child_process.execSync to set bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures, then recoveryenabled No, with shell:true, stdio ignore and empty catch.
effects: Disables boot-failure handling and automatic recovery
t.limitations: Failure of the first command skips the second. Windows rights and invocation are unobserved; no elevation is implemented.
t.marker_note: osinthell t.js: disables boot recovery and failure handling

moved.reason: The filename alone does not establish a password-store or password-acquisition claim. Matcher, severity, confidence and type/platform scope are unchanged. Remove unsupported atomic T1555.003 mapping; consuming credential-access composites retain their own mappings.
moved.consumers: All four explicit consumers updated. Ancestor-selector audit found only fs-wide references; fs/path membership is retained and no password-store-directory selectors were present.

changes.added: Notable AppleScript system attribute USER query, including escaped quotes in reconstructed native text; os/env/user-info is the source-specific home.

checks.new_controls: Six plain/escaped query, attribute/reference and database-filename near-miss controls passed.
checks.retained_controls: 43 assertions across 22 explicit source fixtures passed; 26 store/phishing assertions across 11 existing fixtures, original native sample and independently decoded command passed. The old oct24 directory-wide harness self-scans its own assertion text; reran its declared source cases explicitly instead.
checks.definition_preservation: Normalized moved definition equals original exactly after removing its unsupported optional attack mapping; all four consumers equal originals after ID substitution.

coverage_limit: The four tiny osinthell exports each implement one destructive outcome, with two overlapping hostile truncation rules on p.js. Inspected every statement, their imports and full package entrypoint. Their execution, disk-write, file-truncation/deletion, recovery configuration and error/output behavior have supported coverage. bootrec repair is separately notable. Three distinct hostile behaviors per export are not present; no evidence or matcher limitation leaves an actual hostile outcome uncovered. No quota-driven traits were added.
activation_context: osinthell index.js imports a-z exports and calls them from sorgu, ignoring userId. Import alone does not call the four actions. Earlier j.js has a synchronous endless allocation loop, so reaching p/t/v through the full entrypoint is not established. Each member is judged by its own implemented behavior.
classifier_gap: All four individual osinthell modules remain calibrated benign (lvl -1), despite accurate hostile rules. Installer and writer remain malicious. Their archives remain detected. Older feature schema version 18 versus expected 21 is reported by atomscan.

native_reproducibility.explanation: A cache-disabled scan against a complete isolated HEAD snapshot reproduces all final native findings, after the moved ID/optional mapping and new query are normalized and index-only uses references are ignored. Initial x86-versus-ARM extraction and omitted generic rollups/metadata are analyzer freshness differences, not YAML attack-coverage loss. All hostile/suspicious IDs are preserved, for every member of every archive too.
